Product: 틸 엘라스틱 북 밴드
Design invariants: Fictional concept sample. Single closed loop of wide teal woven elastic book band with one small rectangular teal leather tab stitched across the band at seam, no buckle clip metal or text, stretches around a closed book vertically. No logos, readable text or watermarks. Preserve geometry and hardware counts.
Base color: deep teal
Base material: woven elastic textile
Studio: warm light gray seamless studio, soft diffused daylight
Straight rear catalog view of the same garment. Preserve construction; do not invent decoration or branding.
One separate photorealistic image only; no collage, text, logos or watermark. Reference images are authoritative. Preserve garment shape, seams, collar, pockets and closures unless explicitly changing that property. For edits change only the requested angle, pose, color or material. Do not depict multiple variants together.

history.note: QA accepted: opposite oval view moves single seam tab to far side, consistent woven teal loop.
